title: The back wall, from inside
logline: The tavern's back wall from inside: the door with the bare bulb, and beside it, low, the gap under the door where twenty years of rent envelopes came through. A receipt pad on a nail.

panels.composition: The tavern's back door from inside: a plain door, a bare bulb, a coat hook, and beside the door on a nail a receipt pad with a pen on a string. The gap under the door showing a line of daylight. The floorboards worn in a path to it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a tavern's plain back door seen from inside with a bare bulb and a receipt pad hanging on a nail beside it, a line of daylight under the door and floorboards worn in a path toward it, no people, no words
image.notes: The landlord's side of dw_2006-11-08 and dw_2006-12-15. The landlord: still not drawn, still not named.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The other side of the door the envelopes went under.
